messages:
kevin: Quick rollup — console observability roadmap status needed for Friday planning. Specifically: tracing hooks, dashboards, error-analysis views, retention milestones. Who's owning each, current blockers, and cross-team deps? cc @maria @jon @sara

maria: I can own dashboard rollouts. PR #412 merged to staging but awaiting final review for the layout changes. Canary target: Tue next week. Blocking: data team needs two schema fields added (trace_id, span_meta) before we can backfill.

jon: Tracing hooks are in a runtime prototype. PR #418 contains the hook + sampling toggles. Next steps: land sampling config + perf test. Need infra to expose a write endpoint (/internal/trace-ingest) and ensure auth scopes. @sara can infra schedule the endpoint exposure?

sara: infra can expose the endpoint, but security review required for the auth scope change. I'll start a security ticket. Ops window looks open Wed PM. ops-bot: security-review-ticket-789 created (owner: tom).

ops-bot: Reminder: security-review-ticket-789 linked to thread 1838762345, SLA 72h.

nina: DevEx will publish dashboard quickstart + migration notes after the canary. I need the final dashboard json and the field mapping (trace_id/span_meta). Planning docs due Thu.

alex: Error-analysis view work in progress — adding a rerun job that groups stack traces + trace context. This depends on retention policy because we sample anomalies over time. I propose initial trace retention = 60d to give enough signal.

helen: Data team: 60d ok for traces but metrics storage cost grows >45d. We can tier cold storage for >45d but need a cost estimate before sign-off. I'll ask finance for a rough delta.

kevin: Noted. Let's capture owners/actions here so we can lock milestones: 
- Dashboards: owner = maria, canary target = Tue next week, blocker = add trace_id/span_meta (data).
- Tracing hooks: owner = jon (eng-runtime), PR #418, infra dependency = expose /internal/trace-ingest (sara), security review (tom).
- Error-analysis: owner = alex, depends on retention decision (helen). Recommend 60d provisional.
- DevEx docs: owner = nina, publish after canary.
- Cost sign-off: owner = helen -> finance estimate for retention tiering.

Please reply with any changes to ownership or ETA. If folks can add PR links or ticket numbers that'd help central tracking.

maria: ack — will paste the final dashboard json once PR review done. pinging @data-team for schema change ticket.

jon: I'll add perf test results to PR and request an eng-runtime code review. tagging @eng-runtime for reviewers.

sara: Security review triage underway, assigned to tom. I'll coordinate infra rollout for Wed PM if review clears.

tom: I'll take the security review today, will post findings in ticket 789.

helen: I'll get a quick cost delta by EOD Thursday and post here. If finance flags >10% increase we'll revisit 60d.

kevin: Great — if no new blockers, I'll lock milestones by EOD Friday and create a summary in the planning doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
